task:
Task M5: Ignore stale responses

Implement View.begin(query)->monotonically increasing request id; View.finish(id, rows)->bool. Only the latest begun request can update rows, once. Older or duplicate replies return False. begin clears loading errors but keeps existing rows until valid finish. Expose loading boolean; copy accepted rows. Preserve notes (job_id -> note) through all requests.

from view import View

v = View()
assert v.begin('q1') == 1
assert v.begin('q2') == 2
assert v.finish(1, [(1, 'a')]) is False
assert v.finish(2, [(1, 'a')]) is True
assert v.rows == [(1, 'a')]
assert v.finish(2, [(2, 'b')]) is False
assert v.finish(3, [(3, 'c')]) is False

v2 = View()
v2.begin('q1')
v2.finish(1, [(1, 'a')])
assert v2.rows == [(1, 'a')]

v3 = View()
v3.begin('q1')
v3.finish(1, [(1, 'a')])
v3.begin('q2')
assert v3.loading is True
assert v3.error is None
assert v3.rows == [(1, 'a')]
v3.finish(2, [(2, 'b')])
assert v3.rows == [(2, 'b')]
assert v3.loading is False
assert v3.finish(2, [(2, 'b')]) is False

v4 = View()
v4.begin('q1')
v4.finish(1, [(1, 'a')])
v4.notes[1] = 'note'
v4.begin('q2')
v4.finish(2, [(2, 'b')])
assert v4.notes[1] == 'note'

v5 = View()
v5.begin('q1')
v5.finish(1, [(1, 'a')])
assert v5.rows == [(1, 'a')]
assert v5.rows is not v5.rows

v6 = View()
v6.begin('q1')
v6.finish(1, [(1, 'a')])
v6.begin('q2')
assert v6.loading is True
assert v6.finish(2, [(2, 'b')]) is True
assert v6.loading is False
assert v6.finish(2, [(2, 'b')]) is False
assert v6.finish(3, [(3, 'c')]) is False

v7 = View()
v7.begin('q1')
assert v7.loading is True
assert v7.finish(1, [(1, 'a')]) is True
assert v7.loading is False

print('all tests passed')
